title: Carpet Bot Idle Walking (Carpet Mod)
description: Allows Any "Carpet Mod Bot" To Walk Around Randomly
body:
**Any Carpet Mod Bots you tag with "normal.bot" will start wandering around randomly every 10 seconds.**

**Commands:**

_enable for a bot_
```
/tag add (Carpet Bot Name) normal.bot
```

_disable for a bot_
```
/tag remove (Carpet Bot Name) normal.bot
```
